title: Ciphertext-only hotspot prior
rationale: This lane predeclares high-scoring non-anchor K4 ciphertext positions before scoring any source-backed observations. It is not another public-anchor mining pass because discovery uses only ciphertext repeated n-gram coverage and shifted self-coincidence endpoints; public anchor positions are used only as an exclusion mask.
prediction_target: Future source-reviewed non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched in the predeclared ciphertext-only hotspot set if the hotspot model has predictive structure beyond a same-size non-anchor position-shuffle null.
discovery_inputs: Repeated n-gram coverage over ciphertext positions for lengths 2 through 4
Shifted ciphertext self-coincidence endpoints for periods 1 through 20
Known solved clue positions used only as an exclusion mask for future non-anchor targets
evaluation_inputs: Future source-reviewed non-anchor K4 position observations selected before scoring
Observation files with per-position source notes and validation against the registered non-anchor universe
Independent target positions that are not public known-plaintext anchor fragments and are not derived from anchor additive-key values
controls: seeded same-size non-anchor position-shuffle baseline for hotspot enrichment
multiple-comparison context across all preregistered independent lanes before interpretation
promotion blocked unless future independent observations beat all predeclared controls without post-hoc retuning
